name: verifies-v1
provenance: Invented for bead-rs under research/specs/clean-room-protocol.md; no record from another bead implementation or a real workspace was consulted. Titles are fixture data only -- the tool under test must never read them.

cases.name: inverted-gate
cases.summary: The classic authoring slip: the checker is ordered ahead of the work it checks, and the check relationship is declared after the gate

cases.name: deliberate-baseline-gate
cases.summary: The legitimate baseline-first reading of the identical edge set (ADR-001): prove the baseline green before anyone touches the work; observably identical to the inversion, so the diagnosis must stay advisory

beads.title: Prove the baseline is green before any work lands

cases.name: declared-check-no-gate
cases.summary: The check relationship alone: declared, persisted, and never eligible-affecting

cases.name: plain-gate-no-declaration
cases.summary: An ordinary gate whose titles a title-shape heuristic would misread as an inversion; with no declared edge the diagnosis must stay silent, because titles are never consulted

beads.title: Add logging verification and run test suite

cases.name: verifies-cycle
cases.summary: A two-bead verifies ring: permitted, because the kind never enters blocks-only cycle detection

cases.name: relates-to-plus-verifies
cases.summary: Every kind coexistence is accepted over one pair: relates_to and verifies on the same two beads, no gate anywhere, so no finding and both beads stay ready

beads.title: Track the retry helper in the milestone notes
